block_bootstrap.method: symbol-aware block bootstrap (resample symbols with replacement, n=1000)
block_bootstrap.interpretation: Block bootstrap mean dir_acc = 0.5650 (95% CI: [0.5195, 0.6117]). P(>0.50) = 0.9980. Majority Vote 5d advantage APPEARS ROBUST to symbol-block resampling.

multiple_testing_adjustment.interpretation: With 33 ensemble-horizon tests, Bonferroni-adjusted alpha = 0.0015. Original h=5d Majority Vote CI [0.516, 0.614] still excludes 0.50, but Bonferroni-adjusted significance requires p < 0.0015 (much stricter). The h=5d finding is robust under standard alpha=0.05 but may be marginal under Bonferroni correction.

honest_conclusion: Under standard alpha=0.05: Majority Vote h=5d dir_acc=0.565 (CI=[0.516, 0.614]) is statistically significant. Block bootstrap confirms robustness to symbol resampling. Under Bonferroni alpha=0.0015 (correcting for 33 ensemble-horizon tests), significance is marginal. Other ensembles (Probability-Weighted, Tier-Weighted) have similar dir_acc but no formal CI computed. h=10d and h=21d Majority Vote CIs include 0.50 — NOT significant.
